assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:hinami-yoko@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #bounded-character-dossier, the canonical B-scope Hinami Yoko bounded attributed character dossier (INDEPENDENT_BOUNDED_LITERARY_SCOPE_PASS, scope B_FOCALIZATION_BOUNDED), whose evidence register is HY-E01 to HY-E10 in Japanese V08.5, V09, V10, V11 and V12, much of it received through Aoi's focalization or Haruka's and Fumiya's reports; and #attributed-retrieval-model, the canonical derived-use attributed retrieval/constraint model (HY1 to HY5), marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from the dossier, enacts no interior and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. The supporting character implementation review, the supporting literary evidence manifest, the historical and context retrieval integration review, operator guide and packet, the accepted Hinami R04 analysis, the readings and the ledgers (CS section 13.6/19, REL section 17.1) are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Hinami 陽子 is distinct from Mamiya 葉子. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Separate access events, not a continuous witnessed life: the V11 childhood comfort and private-room history, the V11 Nagisa advice and retaliation history and hospital scene (undated within the unreconciled V10/V11 school-year conflict), the V08.5 middle-school cooking and game observation, the V09 restaurant encounter as a story-present scene, the V10 cutoff and V11 continuation of the birthday video, and Aoi's V12 private clarification and re-reception; no new direct maternal testimony after V11 and no later response of hers is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The dossier's governing account is material care, praise and social warmth coexisting with a persistent explanation that converts harm and Nagisa's death into meaningful trial (sections 2, 4 and 5), tested against six rival accounts (malicious disguise, harmless love, one identical formula, named religion or diagnosis, sole cause, V12 reform) with dispositions; the model retrieves it as HY1 to HY5. C is rejected because her motive is explicitly open between protective concern, coping and encouragement, almost all access is through her daughters, and the model is retrieval-only with no tested prediction. E is rejected because the account is distributed across several eras and recipients and tested against named rivals.

Her conduct is located at several separated times (childhood comfort, Nagisa's advice and retaliation, the hospital, V08.5 middle-school cooking, the V09 restaurant, the birthday video), and the dossier keeps their disclosure clocks apart (section 1). C is rejected because no development in her is witnessed, the historical bands are undated within the school-year conflict, and her later response is explicitly unshown (section 7). E is rejected because behavior is located at multiple distinct times with explicit clock separation.

The discovery row does not claim SPEECH. Located utterances include repeated welcome and birth-thanks language, the residual-heat cooking explanation, the remark that Aoi looks happy while losing, the trial and opportunity framing, the world-chosen-meaning explanation and the recorded birthday greeting; the model awards no new Japanese dialogue, idiolect or acoustics. D is rejected because no register features are described and much speech is retold in focalized narration; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the utterances are located.

Multiple distinct ordinary acts are located: cooking cheese-filled hamburger steak with a residual-heat technique and sitting with Aoi (V08.5 part0013 P172-192), observing the game (part0015 P146-165), the cheesecake comfort with the thigh-bump (V11 p0030 P721-825), and greeting classmates and prompting Haruka at the restaurant (V09 part0023 P29-72). C is rejected because these are a handful of scenes with no occupation, routine or biography established; E is rejected because several distinct ordinary acts are paragraph-located across eras.

The dossier's section 8 matrix separates eight recipient and time rows (distressed child Aoi, middle-school Aoi, Nagisa seeking advice, Nagisa under retaliation, the surviving children after the death, Haruka's reports, the V09 classmates, the video recipient), each with a limit, and the model's HY2 makes social warmth recipient-varying while HY5 keeps the daughters' receptions distinct. B is rejected because each recipient rests on one or two scenes, much is received through Aoi's focalization, and no current interaction model exists. D is rejected because explicit recipient-specific acts and limits exceed a relational sketch.

The dossier states it gives no complete maternal interior; inward narration is Aoi's, Fumiya's judgment of her smile is his, and only her visible grief at the hospital is firmly established (HY-E06). D is rejected because no interior of hers is directly rendered; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly characterizes what is and is not accessible.

Located frictions are indirect: her bright acceptance of Aoi's withdrawn question (felt by Aoi as colder), her continued return to the same explanation as Aoi rejects it and flees from the hospital, and light teasing of Aoi's impatience in V09. D is rejected because no confrontation she conducts is shown and her response to open dissent is not represented; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the frictions are located.

Her own normative statements are located: praising Nagisa's wish and promising support, offering watching without intervening as a possible choice, framing the persecution as a trial for growth, and explaining the death as world-chosen meaning (HY-E05, HY-E06). C is rejected because no weighing is rendered, her motive is open, and the faith context is unidentified. E is rejected because these are repeated located normative acts of hers, not only observer judgments.

Located instances: the thigh-bump and brisk hopping toward the kitchen that Aoi finds warmly funny (HY-E03) and teasing Aoi's wish to end the restaurant meeting (HY-E04). D is rejected because these are two instances and the dossier rejects a universal clumsiness trait; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because they are located.

An independently reviewed B-scope dossier with exact member and paragraph windows HY-E01 to HY-E10 across V08.5 to V12, paired with an accepted attributed retrieval model. C is rejected because the account is focalization-bounded and the reviews, manifest, packet, readings and ledgers are not curated on this subject; E is rejected because it is independently reviewed with exact located windows across five volumes.

Affirmative located limits: Aoi says her mother's and Haruka's faces were already familiar and the acute reminder was the long-unseen prayer room and scroll (V12 p0022 P59-78); Aoi notices supportive words without concrete change to Nagisa's situation (HY-E05); Nagisa acts despite her caution; love and grief coexist with an explanation Aoi cannot bear; the V08.5 window does not name her; she is distinct from Mamiya 葉子; six rival accounts are disposed. B is rejected because each limit rests on one scene and much of it is focalized; D is rejected because these are located, subject-specific limits rather than gap statements.

The dossier separates the childhood history, the middle-school V08.5 scenes, the V09 present encounter, the V10 video cutoff, the V11 continuation and the V12 private clarification, and keeps the retrospective name link from becoming an earlier disclosure; HY4 binds heard words and private reminders to separate clocks. B is rejected because the historical bands are undated and inherit the school-year conflict; D is rejected because claims are bound to exact windows and disclosure events.

scenario_readiness.note: The model supplies no new first-person voice, no new Japanese dialogue and no idiolect, and most of her speech is retold through Aoi-centered narration. CONDITIONAL would generate a maternal voice from retold utterances; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds voice.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One of the represented access events only: the childhood comfort history, the Nagisa advice and retaliation history, the hospital scene, the V08.5 middle-school household, the V09 restaurant encounter or the birthday video; nothing after V12 and no new maternal response.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their represented standing: Aoi as distressed child or middle-school daughter, Nagisa seeking advice or under retaliation, Aoi and Haruka as surviving children, and Fumiya and Kikuchi as Aoi's classmates.
setting_constraints: The family home, the hospital, the V09 restaurant and the recorded video only
No named faith or organization, diagnosis, present remorse, reform or father-absence explanation
Output would be attributed retrieval with labeled alternatives, never an enacted persona or new dialogue

scenario_readiness.note: The model is manual attributed retrieval and places current grief counseling or parenting enactment outside its admission; the dossier says a challenge to the death's meaning cannot establish how she would answer a later adult conversation and that no blinded model test exists. CONDITIONAL would enact a focalized parent in new contexts; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds transfer.

Ordinary company is located (the V09 restaurant, the V08.5 meal), and the model can retrieve food, company, humor and recipient limits from that record, but it is a retrieval model with no executable persona and the V09 encounter is one scene. CONDITIONAL would generate ordinary social behavior the model declines to enact; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the encounters and their limits are located.

Her explanatory framework and advice are located, but no weighing is rendered, her motive is open, and the model admits only retrieval of historical injury, not new ethical enactment. CONDITIONAL would invent reasoning the source attributes only through her daughters; NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because her located normative acts bound the scenario.

The only related fact is Haruka's short report that the father has long been absent, with no cause; no romantic or marital conduct of hers is in the curated items, and neither item models it. Nothing is established either way.
No occupation or work role is established; the dossier declines to infer one from clothing or apparent age. Nothing is established either way.

known_limits.statement: Aoi says she was already used to her mother's and Haruka's faces; the acute reminder in the video was the long-unseen prayer room and the illegible scroll in its cabinet (V12 p0022 P59-78), so 'she cannot bear her mother's face' is too broad.
The birthday video is an actual recorded maternal address (V11 p0011 P1-26), but whether she anticipated Aoi's response or intended to reactivate the past is not established.
Touch, food, the shared cake and grief at the hospital are represented acts received as care (HY-E03, HY-E06); a malicious-disguise reading is rejected by the evidence.
Aoi's focalized criticism that her support did nothing concrete to change Nagisa's situation (V11 p0030 P826-943) is consequential but is not a census of every adult or school contact.
Nagisa acted despite her caution, and bullying, missing institutional responses and competing prevention hypotheses remain; she is not established as a sole cause of the death.
Aoi's withdrawn dinner question is reader access to Aoi; it is not shown that Yoko read and suppressed it.
The V08.5 domestic window calls her mother without naming her; the link to 陽子 is retrospective, and she is distinct from Mamiya 葉子.
V12 changes Aoi's private reading and address; no new Yoko apology, manuscript reading, room discussion or family repair is shown, and neither reform nor permanent inability to change is supported.
The private room, scroll and practice are represented without a named religion, organization, doctrine or diagnosis.
Her complete beliefs, present interior, occupation, adult biography and the reason for the father's absence are not supplied.
The implementation and integration reviews, manifest, packet, operator guide, R04 analysis, readings and ledgers are not curated on this subject.
No idiolect, habitual distribution or acoustic manner is established and generated speech was not evaluated.
